Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators
• Forklift drivers
• Loaders and unloaders
• Overhead crane operators
• Saw machine operators
• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.
• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.
• You have solid technical insight.
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.
Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.
• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.
• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we are seeking 100% EV Car Technicians.

In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, vehicle diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, and more.

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification   working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.?

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

You work organized as you will have to create reports to show results of the performed activities.

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2
• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion
• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)
• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making
• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization
• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning
• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation
• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C  , and Python
• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization
• Control systems for robotics
• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)
• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics
• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment
• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work
• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)
• You can communicate fluently in English

Primary Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and refine yeast extract-driven solutions for a variety of savory food applications, including soups, stocks, sauces, and snack flavoring systems.
 
• Drive recipe creation and continuous optimization to improve flavor intensity, enhance umami profiles, and achieve balanced taste performance.
 
• Perform sensory assessments and analyze evaluation results to support product development and strategic market positioning.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market insights into effective, scalable, and commercially viable formulations.
 
• Investigate ingredient functionality within complex food systems and resolve technical formulation issues.
 
• Carry out market intelligence activities, including competitive product reviews and emerging trend monitoring in savory applications.
 
• Provide technical support for customer projects through prototype development, problem resolution, and product demonstrations.
 
• Work closely with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to accelerate innovation initiatives and business growth.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements, quality standards, and internal product development procedures.

Profile & Expertise

 
• Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
 
• Demonstrated expertise in product formulation and application development within one or more savory segments such as soups, seasonings, sauces, or bouillons.
 
• Outstanding junior professionals with strong academic achievements, internships, or relevant project experience are welcome to apply.
 
• Solid knowledge of sensory science, flavor characterization, and sensory-driven product development.
 
• Strong understanding of ingredient performance, flavor synergy, and behavior within food systems.
 
• Capable of planning and executing experiments independently while drawing meaningful conclusions from technical data.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on formulation improvement and optimization.
 
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external clients.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer and business needs.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 
• Availability for occasional travel across Europe for customer meetings, industry exhibitions, and knowledge-sharing sessions at the company's headquarters in China.

Core Responsibilities

 
• Develop, refine, and enhance bakery solutions utilizing yeast-based ingredients, including baker's yeast, yeast extracts, yeast proteins, and other specialty baking components.
 
• Plan and conduct practical baking trials tailored to customer needs while aligning with current European bakery market demands and consumer trends.
 
• Lead recipe formulation and continuous product optimization for breads, viennoiseries, laminated pastries, and a wide range of fermented baked goods.
 
• Deliver technical expertise and customized product solutions to strategic customers and bakery manufacturers throughout Europe.
 
• Organize and perform bakery demonstrations in customer facilities, application centers, and industry exhibitions, both for individual clients and larger groups.
 
• Translate customer specifications and commercial opportunities into scalable formulations and effective technical recommendations.
 
• Partner closely with commercial, marketing, and global R&D teams to support innovation initiatives and business growth objectives.
 
• Monitor industry developments, competitor offerings, ingredient innovations, and advances in bakery processing technologies.
 
• Ensure all development activities comply with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

 
• Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Baking Technology, Milling Technology, or a related field. Practical bakery training or hands-on experience as a baker is highly valued.
 
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in bakery product development, ideally within premix manufacturers, industrial bakeries, or yeast ingredient companies.
 
• Strong expertise in bakery ingredient functionality, dough behavior, flour performance evaluation, and process optimization.
 
• Proven ability to design trials, analyze technical results, identify root causes, and resolve formulation challenges.
 
• Hands-on and solution-oriented professional capable of working autonomously in a laboratory and application environment.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to transform technical expertise into tangible customer benefits.
 
• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working across departments and directly with customers.
 
• Excellent presentation and communication abilities, including delivering technical training sessions, demonstrations, and customer workshops.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, for international collaboration; knowledge of French or Dutch is considered an asset.
 
• Flexible and willing to travel across Europe for customer meetings, trade fairs, and knowledge-sharing visits to the company's headquarters in China.

Key Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and enhance yeast-protein-based solutions for a range of food applications, including sports nutrition products, plant-based dairy substitutes, and baked goods.
 
• Drive recipe development and continuous prototype improvement to achieve targeted functionality, such as texture enhancement, emulsification, gel formation, and overall product performance.
 
• Analyze sensory evaluation results and transform insights into actionable recommendations for formulation refinement and product advancement.
 
• Perform competitive product assessments and monitor industry developments related to proteins and functional ingredients.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market expectations into effective technical concepts and scalable product solutions.
 
• Provide technical expertise for customer-focused projects, including prototype preparation, issue resolution, and technical demonstrations.
 
• Partner with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to deliver innovative products aligned with business objectives.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory guidelines, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Skills

 
• Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or a closely related field.
 
• Demonstrated background in product formulation and application development within food systems such as sports nutrition, plant-based alternatives, bakery products, or similar sectors. Talented early-career candidates with relevant academic projects or internship exposure are welcome to apply.
 
• Strong expertise in sensory assessment, product characterization, and structured evaluation methodologies.
 
• In-depth knowledge of ingredient performance, protein functionality, and interactions within complex food matrices.
 
• Ability to independently plan trials, execute experiments, and draw meaningful conclusions from technical findings.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities related to formulation challenges and product improvement.
 
• Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and engage with customers.
 
• Commercial awareness and the capability to translate technical innovations into business and customer benefits.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written, for international collaboration.
 
• Flexibility to travel for customer meetings, industry exhibitions throughout Europe, and knowledge-sharing activities with the headquarters in China.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), 
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are currently hiring an Operations Line Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams.

Your job:
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Operations & Planning

• Translate weekly production plans into daily priorities
• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Coordinate with planning and support teams
Team Leadership

• Lead and coach Team Leaders, Mechanics and Inspectors
• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
Safety & Quality

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:
You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.

• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about logistics? Join our team at SAESB as a Logistics Administrator and play a vital role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across our operations.

Your role:
Are you detail-oriented, well-organized, and interested in logistics processes? We are looking for a Logistics Administrator to manage the entire administrative process for shipping and receiving goods. You will ensure timely deliveries while monitoring compliance with customs regulations.

Your responsibilities:
Administrative support for goods movement:

• Prepare shipping and receiving documents (such as Air Waybills and pro forma invoices).
• Create and follow up on purchase requisitions and orders in the ERP system.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date data in IT systems.
Transport coordination:

• Schedule and monitor all transport bookings, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Customs compliance:

• Verify and ensure adherence to applicable customs laws and regulations.
• Review documents for inbound and outbound shipments.
Reporting:

• Prepare and submit periodic reports on imports and exports.

Your Impact:

• Serve as the first point of contact for daily transport-related queries.
• Ensure timely and complete administrative handling of shipments and related reporting.
• Maintain proper documentation for customs and compliance purposes.

Your profile:

• A higher education degree.
• Solid proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems.
• Practical knowledge of ADR regulations, customs laws, and Incoterms (or willingness to follow training).
• Understanding of logistics operations, including both road and air freight.
• A structured and precise approach, consistently following established procedures.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset, able to anticipate and prevent issues.
• Flexibility to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Able to work independently after a six-month training period.
• Proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, sufficient for both internal communication and contacts with external suppliers.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - International clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected Belgian boutique advisory firm founded by two former lawyers from leading international law firms. The organization supports high-profile prestigious clients and their families throughout every stage of their personal and professional journey.

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

With a close-knit team of around 10-15 professionals, the company offers an entrepreneurial environment where quality, trust, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Advise and assist clients on a wide range of legal matters.
• Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
• Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
• Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
• Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
• Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
• Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
• Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
• Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
• Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Belgian Master's degree in Law 
• Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Fluent in Dutch & English
• Proactive and hands-on personality.
• Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
• Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.
